acceptanceCriteria: corvint affected, init and overview return repository-ownership-refused naming the repository when Git refuses for dubious ownership.
A maintained test per command fails without the fix.
body: Residual from the affected-1021s lane (PR #1509, V1-0288, GPK-V0-071). Query/prove paths now map Git's dubious-ownership failure to one coded repository-ownership-refused refusal naming the repository, but corvint affected, init and overview still swallow Git's stderr and emit a generic failure. Expected: the same coded refusal on every Git-backed command.
title: affected, init and overview swallow Git's dubious-ownership stderr instead of the GPK-V0-071 repository-ownership-refused refusal
